# Deep-dive run-to-run reliability (Supp. Fig. S15)

## Figure legend — Supplementary Figure 15

*Verbatim from the manuscript. Generated by
`scripts/figures/sync_readme_legends.py` — edit the manuscript and
re-run; do not hand-edit inside these markers.*

> **Supplementary Figure 15.** Deep-dive records are reproducible, and most run-to-run differences come from which papers are retrieved. We re-analyzed 50 randomly selected deep-dive proteins in two ways and compared each of the 24 LLM-derived fields, plus the surface call and confidence tier, with the published record. In the full re-run (maroon, solid), we repeated the entire pipeline from literature discovery onward with identical prompts. In the fixed-evidence replay (lavender, dotted), we reused each record's selected evidence and re-ran only the section builders and synthesizer. Points show Cohen's κ versus the published record, with 95% intervals from 5,000 bootstrap resamples of proteins. Ordered fields use linearly weighted κ, and all others use unweighted κ. State dependence and co-receptor dependency exclude unclear and unknown calls (n shown). Green shading marks moderate (0.60–0.79), strong (0.80–0.90) and almost perfect (>0.90) agreement (McHugh, 2012). Induction trigger is scored as a single dominant trigger, although several can apply to one protein. Shed form is rare (4 of 50 proteins), which lowers κ despite 92% raw agreement.
<!-- END manuscript-legend -->

How reproducible is a deep-dive record? Fifty proteins were drawn at random
from the 5,332 deep-dive records and re-analysed two ways, and every one of the
24 LLM-derived filter fields — plus the derived surface call and five-tier
confidence spectrum — was compared with the published record as **Cohen's κ**:

- **Full re-run** (maroon, solid) — the whole pipeline again with identical
  prompts, three months later: literature discovery, abstract triage, paper
  selection, section builders and synthesizer.
- **Fixed-evidence replay** (lavender, dotted) — each published record's own
  evidence ledger re-used; only the section builders and synthesizer re-run.

The gap between the two isolates how much run-to-run variation comes from which
papers are retrieved and kept: holding the evidence fixed raises the surface
call from κ = 0.82 to 0.95 and the confidence tier from 0.85 to 0.92.

> Ordered fields use linearly weighted κ; nominal fields and yes/no flags use
> unweighted κ. State dependence and co-receptor dependency are scored on their
> ordered levels only (`unclear` / `unknown` excluded; each row prints its n).
> Bars are 95% percentile intervals from 5,000 paired bootstrap resamples of
> genes; with n = 50 they are wide, and a rare flag (shed form, 4/50) can have
> a low κ despite 92% raw agreement.

## Reproduce

```bash
uv run make_deep_dive_replicate_kappa.py
```

Writes `deep_dive_replicate_kappa.pdf` and `.png` next to the script, from the
TSV bundled in this gist (outside the gist, from the in-repo copy).

## Data

| File | Rows | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `deep_dive_replicate_kappa.tsv` | 100 | One row per gene per `comparison` (`full_rerun` or `fixed_evidence_replay`, 50 each): per field, the published and re-analysed (`_reanalysis`) values and `_match` / `_soft_match` flags; tier on both sides; cited-paper overlap (`cited_jaccard`) |

Every row carries stable identifiers (`hgnc_id`, `hgnc_symbol`, `uniprot_acc`,
`ensembl_gene`, `ncbi_gene_id`) and its `sample_batch` (two disjoint random
batches of 25, seeds 20260927 and 20260928).

**Lineage.** The TSV is built by
[`scripts/build/build_deep_dive_concordance_tsvs.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/build/build_deep_dive_concordance_tsvs.py)
from the frozen record bundle in
[`data/processed/deep_dive_concordance_v1/`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/tree/main/data/processed/deep_dive_concordance_v1)
(the published, full re-run and replay records for all 50 genes). The canonical
figure generator is
[`scripts/figures/deep_dive_replicate_kappa.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/figures/deep_dive_replicate_kappa.py).
